{{Short description|Romanian professor of engineering}}
'''Paul Dan A. Cristea''' (13 February 1941, [[Bucharest]] – 17 April 2013<ref name="Gândul_2013-04-18">{{Citation | url=https://www.gandul.ro/stiri/a-murit-academicianul-paul-cristea-10762657#| title=A murit academicianul Paul Cristea - Gândul| newspaper=Gândul| date= 18 April 2013| access-date=1 September 2020}}</ref>) was a Romanian professor of engineering. He was named an [[Fellow of the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers|IEEE EMBS Fellow]] in 2012 "for contributions to modernizing and internationalizing engineering education".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.embs.org/about-embs/awards-recognition/fellow-program/2012-embs-fellows/|title=2012 EMBS Fellows|publisher=EMBS|access-date=31 December 2019|archive-date=18 September 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200918225806/https://www.embs.org/about-embs/awards-recognition/fellow-program/2012-embs-fellows/|url-status=dead}}</ref> He was fellow of the prestigious Academy of Scientists of Romania https://www.aosr.ro/

==Education and career==
Cristea got his master's degrees from the Department of Electronics and Telecommunications of the [[Politehnica University of Bucharest]] and from the Department of Physics at the [[University of Bucharest]] in 1962. In 1970, he got his Ph.D. from the Polytechnic Institute of Bucharest, and, after graduation, remained at the university. Between 1962 and 1990, Cristea served as assistant, associate, professor, and full professor at his alma mater and was a founder of the Digital Signal Processing Laboratory at the Politehnica University of Bucharest. Since 2005, Cristea was an associate editor and member of the editorial board of the ''EURASIP Journal on Bioinformatics & Systems Biology''.<ref>{{cite journal|author=Ioan Tabus|author2=Erchin Serpedin|author3=Jaakko Astola|title=Obituary: Professor Paul Dan Cristea|journal=EURASIP Journal on Bioinformatics & Systems Biology|year=2013|volume=2013|issue=1|page=7|doi=10.1186/1687-4153-2013-7|pmc=3656793|pmid=23663854 |doi-access=free }}</ref>

In 2011 he became a full member of the [[Romanian Academy]].<ref name="Acad.ro_2020-09-01">{{Citation | url=https://acad.ro/bdar/armembriLit.php?vidT=C| title=Academia Romana (membri)| newspaper=Acad.ro| access-date=1 September 2020}}</ref>
